title: Chronicle Runtime Config
description: Runtime configuration loaded from config.json. This is part of the v1 scenario package contract. All fields are optional; missing fields receive runtime defaults.

model_path.description: Path to the GGUF model file. Empty string disables AI dialogue and falls back to stub output.

n_gpu_layers.description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU. -1 means all layers; 0 forces CPU-only.

save_directory.description: Directory where save files are written. Empty string defaults to 'saves' relative to cwd.

mutation_narration_templates.description: Per-mutation narration templates. Keys are MutationRequest::Type strings; values may use {npc}, {item}, {mood}, {location} placeholders. Empty value suppresses narration.
